title: api: swagger ImageManifestSummary.ImageData: fix invalid required field
body:
- relates to https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/47526


### api: swagger ImageManifestSummary.ImageData: fix invalid required field

The `UnpackedSize` field was added in 050afe1e1abe699972c96735ad9ec7815a497b81,
which originally had it as a top-level field, but later moved it to
`Size.Unpacked`.

This caused issues with current (v3.6) versions of go-swagger, which added
validation for this;

    2026/09/22 12:33:56 reading config from /go/src/github.com/moby/moby/api/swagger-gen.yaml
    2026/09/22 12:33:56 validating spec /go/src/github.com/moby/moby/api/swagger.yaml
    The swagger spec at "/go/src/github.com/moby/moby/api/swagger.yaml" is invalid against the swagger specification 2.0. See errors :
    - "UnpackedSize" is present in required but not defined as property in schema "ImageManifestSummary.ImageData"
